import sqlite3


def open_store(path):
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT)')
    return db


def save_order(db, body):
    return db.execute('INSERT INTO orders (body) VALUES (?)', (body,)).lastrowid
